records.jp: この感じ久しぶりだなぁ
records.en_original: I feel like I haven't done this in ages.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like I haven't done this in ages.
records.en: I haven't done this in so long.

records.jp: 体育の授業みたいだよね
records.en_original: Yeah, it feels like we're getting ready for gym.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it feels like we're getting ready for gym.
records.en: Yeah, it feels like we're getting ready for gym.

records.jp: やっば、日焼け止め忘れた
records.en_original: Shoot, I forgot my sunscreen.
records.en_auxiliary: Shoot, I forgot my sunscreen.
records.en: Shoot, I forgot my sunscreen.

records.jp: 持ってるよー
records.en_original: You can borrow mine.
records.en_auxiliary: You can borrow mine.
records.en: I've got some~

records.jp: さっすが！
records.en_original: Thanks!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks!
records.en: Knew I could count on you!

records.jp: さて、どのアヒルをお供にするか……
records.en_original: Hmm, which rubber ducky should I bring...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, which rubber ducky should I bring...?
records.en: Now, which rubber ducky shall accompany me...?

records.jp: これ……は……
records.en_original: Oh...man...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...man...
records.en: This... is...

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: いや、何でもない！<CR>私もさっさと着替えようっと
records.en_original: Uh, nothing! Sorry, I'll hurry up and get changed.
records.en_auxiliary: Uh, nothing! Sorry, I'll hurry up and get changed.
records.en: No, it's nothing!<CR>I should hurry up and change too.

records.jp: （あんな水着、人前で着れるわけ……）
records.en_original: (I can't wear that in front of everyone!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I can't wear that in front of everyone!)
records.en: (There is no way I can wear that swimsuit in front of everyone...)

records.jp: あ～、沁みる～
records.en_original: Ahh... This water feels so good on my weary bones...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh... This water feels so good on my weary bones...
records.en: Ahh, this hits the spot~

records.jp: 極楽、極楽
records.en_original: That's the stuff...
records.en_auxiliary: That's the stuff...
records.en: This is paradise.

records.jp: 二人ともおじいちゃんみたい
records.en_original: You two sound like old men!
records.en_auxiliary: You two sound like old men!
records.en: You two sound like grandpas.

records.jp: よし、あたしはバタフライの練習を……
records.en_original: Time to practice my butterfly stroke!
records.en_auxiliary: Time to practice my butterfly stroke!
records.en: All right, time to practice my butterfly stroke...

records.jp: あんたは若すぎ
records.en_original: You have way too much energy.
records.en_auxiliary: You have way too much energy.
records.en: You're too young.

records.jp: やっぱり湯舟に浸かるのっていいね。<CR>心が落ち着くっていうか
records.en_original: There really is nothing like a good soak in the bath. I feel so relaxed.
records.en_auxiliary: There really is nothing like a good soak in the bath. I feel so relaxed.
records.en: Soaking in a bathtub really is nice.<CR>It calms the mind.

records.jp: たしかに、考え事とかに向いてそう
records.en_original: Yeah. It feels like the perfect place to organize your thoughts.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It feels like the perfect place to organize your thoughts.
records.en: It does seem suited for thinking.

records.jp: こうやってお風呂に浸かって考えてたら、<CR>いい施設の案、パッと出てきたりしないかなぁ
records.en_original: Hmm, I wonder if soaking in here could help us come up with any good ideas for new facilities.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, I wonder if soaking in here could help us come up with any good ideas for new facilities.
records.en: Maybe if I think while soaking in the bath,<CR>a good idea for a facility will suddenly come to me.

records.jp: これはネタ出しのためだから。<CR>他の水着が洗濯中で、仕方なく着てるだけだから
records.en_original: I'm just here to try and come up with some ideas. My other swimsuit is in the wash, so I had to wear this one.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just here to try and come up with some ideas. My other swimsuit is in the wash, so I had to wear this one.
records.en: This is for coming up with ideas.<CR>My other swimsuit is in the wash, so I had no choice.

records.jp: （でも、この水着やっぱりかわいいな……）
records.en_original: (This swimsuit really is cute, though...)
records.en_auxiliary: (This swimsuit really is cute, though...)
records.en: (This swimsuit really is cute, though...)

records.jp: ひっ！？
records.en_original: Eek!
records.en_auxiliary: Eek!
records.en: Eek!

records.jp: あれ？　日菜子さんときらら？<CR>なんか珍しい組み合わせだね
records.en_original: Huh? Hinako and Kirara? That's an unusual combination.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Hinako and Kirara? That's an unusual combination.
records.en: Huh? Hinako-san and Kirara?<CR>That's an unusual combination.

records.jp: ほら、最初にお風呂の提案してたの<CR>きららだったでしょ？
records.en_original: Really? Kirara was the one who first suggested building a bath.
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Kirara was the one who first suggested building a bath.
records.en: Remember, Kirara was the one<CR>who first suggested the bath, right?

records.jp: ああ、なるほど。<CR>それでお風呂好き同士で入ってたのか
records.en_original: Oh, true. Glad to see you two have found some common ground.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, true. Glad to see you two have found some common ground.
records.en: Ah, I see.<CR>So two bath lovers were soaking together.

records.jp: うむ。夜の露天風呂はまた格別。<CR>ほら……
records.en_original: Indeed. And going for a nighttime soak is even better. Look...
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. And going for a nighttime soak is even better. Look...
records.en: Indeed. An outdoor bath at night is exceptional.<CR>Look...

records.jp: ……流れ星！
records.en_original: ...A shooting star!
records.en_auxiliary: ...A shooting star!
records.en: ...A shooting star!

records.jp: あぁ、また間に合わなかった～
records.en_original: Agh, too slow again!
records.en_auxiliary: Agh, too slow again!
records.en: Ah, I missed it again~

records.jp: 願い事を言うやつ？
records.en_original: Are you making a wish?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you making a wish?
records.en: Are you making a wish?

records.jp: うん。咄嗟に３回も言うの難しいよ～
records.en_original: Yeah. You have to say it three times in your head, but I can never do it in time.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. You have to say it three times in your head, but I can never do it in time.
records.en: Yeah. It's hard to say it three times on the spur of the moment.

records.jp: 仕方ない。それなら、きららが代わりに聴いてやろう
records.en_original: That is a shame. Very well, I shall listen to your desires.
records.en_auxiliary: That is a shame. Very well, I shall listen to your desires.
records.en: Then Kirara will listen in its place.

records.jp: 「それなら」って、どういうこと？<CR>もしかして、単に私の願いを聞きたいだけ？
records.en_original: What's with that high-and-mighty attitude? You just want to know what I wished for.
records.en_auxiliary: What's with that high-and-mighty attitude? You just want to know what I wished for.
records.en: "Then"? What does that mean?<CR>Do you simply want to hear my wish?

records.jp: ばれたか
records.en_original: You got me...
records.en_auxiliary: You got me...
records.en: You got me...

records.jp: でも、確かに気になる。<CR>何を言おうとしたの？
records.en_original: I'm curious too. What were you going to say?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm curious too. What were you going to say?
records.en: But now I am curious too.<CR>What were you trying to say?

records.jp: 愛央の願いは、なんなのだ？
records.en_original: What is your wish, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What is your wish, Ao?
records.en: What is Ao's wish?

records.jp: 私の願い、か……
records.en_original: My wish...
records.en_auxiliary: My wish...
records.en: My wish...

records.jp: （“特別”になりたい。<CR>ずっとずっとそう思ってた）
records.en_original: (For so long, I thought that I wanted to be special.)
records.en_auxiliary: (For so long, I thought that I wanted to be special.)
records.en: (I want to be "special."<CR>I have always, always felt that way.)

records.jp: （けど、この世界に来て……<CR>いろんな不思議なことを見てきて……）
records.en_original: (But since coming to this world and seeing so many strange things...)
records.en_auxiliary: (But since coming to this world and seeing so many strange things...)
records.en: (But after coming to this world...<CR>and seeing so many strange things...)

records.jp: （なんだかわからなくなっちゃった）
records.en_original: (I'm not sure if that's what I want anymore.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm not sure if that's what I want anymore.)
records.en: (I no longer know what I want.)

records.jp: （“特別”って、なんなんだろう？）
records.en_original: (I mean... What does it even mean to be special?)
records.en_auxiliary: (I mean... What does it even mean to be special?)
records.en: (What does being "special" even mean?)

records.jp: ずっとゴロゴロできますように！<CR>……かな？
records.en_original: I want to be able to laze around all day, every day! ...I guess?
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be able to laze around all day, every day! ...I guess?
records.en: I wish I could laze around forever!<CR>...Maybe?

records.jp: ふざけているだろう
records.en_original: Are you messing with us?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you messing with us?
records.en: You are joking.

records.jp: いやいや、大マジ。<CR>このままずっと毎日こんな生活してたい
records.en_original: No, no, I'm super serious! I wish I could live like this forever.
records.en_auxiliary: No, no, I'm super serious! I wish I could live like this forever.
records.en: No, I'm completely serious.<CR>I want to keep living like this every day forever.

records.jp: やっぱりふざけてる
records.en_original: She's definitely messing with us.
records.en_auxiliary: She's definitely messing with us.
records.en: She is joking after all.

records.jp: 愛央はパス。<CR>他のみんなの願い事を聴くことにする
records.en_original: Okay, you have forfeited your right to talk. Moving on...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, you have forfeited your right to talk. Moving on...
records.en: Kirara will skip Ao.<CR>Kirara will listen to everyone else's wishes.

records.jp: 願い事、か。<CR>せっかくだし笹と短冊でも用意しよっか
records.en_original: Speaking of wishes... We should have a mini-Tanabata! I'll get a bamboo stalk and some paper.
records.en_auxiliary: Speaking of wishes... We should have a mini-Tanabata! I'll get a bamboo stalk and some paper.
records.en: Wishes, huh?<CR>Since we're here, shall we prepare bamboo and tanzaku?

records.jp: ないすあいであ
records.en_original: Excellent idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Excellent idea.
records.en: Nice idea.

records.jp: えーん、そんなぁ……
records.en_original: Really? Seems like a lot of effort...
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Seems like a lot of effort...
records.en: Nooo, come on...

records.jp: あーあ、ずっと夏休みだったらいいのにな
records.en_original: Ahh, I wish summer vacation could last forever...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, I wish summer vacation could last forever...
records.en: Ahh, I wish summer vacation could last forever...

records.jp: ……本当に
records.en_original: I really do...
records.en_auxiliary: I really do...
records.en: ...I really wish it could.

records.jp: ところで愛央
records.en_original: By the way, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, Ao.
records.en: By the way, Ao.

records.jp: ん？　何？
records.en_original: Hm? What?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? What?
records.en: Hm? What?

records.jp: その水着はどうした？
records.en_original: Why did you choose to wear that?
records.en_auxiliary: Why did you choose to wear that?
records.en: What's with that swimsuit?

records.jp: えっ！　あっ、これはその……
records.en_original: Urk! This? Well, I...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk! This? Well, I...
records.en: Huh?! Oh, this is...

records.jp: 似合ってると思うよ。普段のイメージとは違ったから<CR>ちょっとびっくりしたけど
records.en_original: It looks good on you. I was just surprised because it is different from what you usually wear.
records.en_auxiliary: It looks good on you. I was just surprised because it is different from what you usually wear.
records.en: I think it suits you.<CR>It surprised me because it differs from your usual image.

records.jp: 愛央はこういうのが趣味だったのか。<CR>みんなにも教えてあげよう
records.en_original: I didn't realize you liked such things. I will inform the others of this as well.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't realize you liked such things. I will inform the others of this as well.
records.en: So Ao likes this sort of thing.<CR>Kirara will tell everyone else.

records.jp: いや、それは勘弁して！
records.en_original: No, please don't!
records.en_auxiliary: No, please don't!
records.en: No, please don't!
